title: Split nvidia_troubleshoot.sh and setup_passwordless_system.sh
objective: Two single-use fix scripts sit over the 250-line cap with no deployed copy, making them safe targets for the entry+lib shape. Move each script's configuration writers into a sourced library beside it, leaving the entry script owning the ordering, the safety checks and the user-facing output. Code moves verbatim; neither script is executed, because both write system configuration this machine depends on.
acceptance_criteria: All four resulting files are under 250 lines; the over-cap total falls 31 -> 29
Every top-level function is verbatim, proved by meta/scripts/verify_shell_split.sh
Each library sources with no side effects and defines every function moved into it
bash -n passes on all four files
No suppression of any kind, and no shellcheck directive added beyond the standard source= comment
out_of_scope: Running either script: one writes /etc/X11 and installs pyroveil, the other writes sudoers and lightdm autologin
nvidia_troubleshoot.sh's trace blocker, which prevents a runtime trace but not a static verification
The phone_focus_mode scripts, which need deploy.sh's copy list to grow in the same commit
verifier: bash meta/scripts/verify_shell_split.sh HEAD <entry> <lib> <entry> for the verbatim claim; sourcing each library in a subshell and checking declare -F for every moved function; bash -n on all four; pre-commit run --files; bash ~/utils/scripts/check_file_length.sh --all.
